title: Traffic spiral arrestor and soft SLO adapter
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation:
High-volume incidents over the past quarter showed recurring 'spiral' behavior where retries + slowpath replays amplify tail latency and trigger regional failovers. This PR introduces a small runtime component (traffic spiral arrestor) that detects escalating retry/queue loops and applies a calibrated dampening token bucket per-route+region.

What this change does (single-string sectioned description):
- Adds a lightweight SpiralArrestor in the serving runtime that tracks request velocity, retry amplification, and slowpath replay counts. When a spiral signature is detected it throttles new requests for the affected route with a soft token-bucket backoff rather than hard-cut circuit breakers, reducing cascading evictions.
- Introduces a SoftSLOAdapter: a controller that maintains a transient SLO warming budget for routes recently impacted by degradation. The adapter adjusts per-route penalty decay and temporarily relaxes strict failover triggers to allow graceful recovery windows.
- Improves region replication for circuit state by adding a compact, eventually-consistent gossip of spiral markers so nearby regions avoid simultaneous hard failovers.
- Includes a targeted hotfix to fix a race where slowpath replay could reinitialize an in-memory KV cache shard leading to a brief correctness glitch under high concurrency.

Files changed (high level):
- runtime/serving/spiral_arrestor.go (new)
- runtime/slo/soft_adapter.go (new)
- runtime/slo/policy_test.go (tests)
- config/policies/spiral_policy.yaml (defaults)
- infra/deploy/rolling_canary.yaml (canary rollout tweak)
- docs/operational/spiral-arrestor.md (operator doc)

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for SpiralArrestor heuristics and token-bucket behavior
- [x] Integration test verifies warmup budget prevents noisy neighbor eviction in CI scenario
- [x] Canary deployment config and gradual rollout plan included
- [x] Operator docs added and alert rules suggested

Rollout plan:
1) Deploy to staging with canary flags enabled for 24h (observability dashboards in the PR)
2) Enable for 5% production traffic, monitor spiral markers and SLO burn rate for 4h
3) Gradually scale to 30% then full rollout if no regressions

Related Linear items and context: ENG-8792 (investigation), ENG-9024 (hotfix for KV replay race).

Notes: This PR intentionally avoids changing core circuit-breaker thresholds; the SoftSLOAdapter lives orthogonally to existing breakers and only exercises soft throttles and penalty decay. The goal is to limit blast radius of retry spirals while maintaining predictable SLO economics.

release_notes: Add traffic spiral arrestor to mitigate retry-amplification spirals and reduce cascading regional failovers.
Introduce Soft SLO Adapter to provide transient warming budgets and penalty decay for faster, smoother recoveries.
Hotfix: resolve KV cache reinitialization race during slowpath replay under extreme concurrency.
Operators: new policy file config/policies/spiral_policy.yaml and docs/operational/spiral-arrestor.md
